question: Should maintainers require live Cloudflare Sandbox proof before merging this Cloudchamber detector, or accept the reporter-supplied cgroup sample plus regression tests?
rationale: The code path is source-proven and narrow, but external PR policy requires real behavior proof and the changed detector affects compatibility-sensitive runtime defaults.

options.title: Require Live Cloudflare Proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output or logs from a Cloudflare Sandbox or Cloudchamber container showing /proc/1/cgroup and the patched detector classifying it as a container before merge.

options.title: Accept Reporter-Sample Risk
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally merge based on the reporter sample and focused tests while owning the risk that live Cloudflare cgroup variants differ.

options.title: Consolidate Detectors First
options.body: Pause this PR and replace it with a detector consolidation plus Cloudchamber matcher if owners do not want another duplicated platform signal.

recommendation.title: Require Live Cloudflare Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output or logs from a Cloudflare Sandbox or Cloudchamber container showing /proc/1/cgroup and the patched detector classifying it as a container before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged the main container-detection precedent PRs and is the clearest routing candidate for proof-sufficiency and compatibility judgment.
